summary_1line: Bharata begs Rama to return and rule Ayodhya, but Rama responds with philosophical reflections on fate, impermanence, and duty.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata stands before Rama in the forest hermitage beside the Mandakini, pleading with folded hands while the gathered princes and sages watch in silence.
Rama sits calmly in the hermitage speaking to the grieving Bharata, surrounded by brothers and ascetics in the quiet forest morning.
The royal brothers perform a dawn fire sacrifice on the bank of the Mandakini river as mist rises over the forest.
